title: test_rpl_messages_vector missing else clause for unknown msg_type values
description:
In python/tests/test_vectors.py lines 2669-2879, test_rpl_messages_vector handles specific msg_type values (malformed, dio, dao, dao_ack, dis, option, dio_with_options, dao_with_options, option_chain) but has no else clause or final assertion.

If a new msg_type value is added to rpl_messages.json vectors, the test would silently pass without exercising any code path.

Fix: Add an else clause with pytest.fail() or assert False to catch unhandled msg_type values.
close_reason: RE-CLOSE (second landing; the first close was lost to another intermittent shared-dolt-store revert): Added fail-loud else clauses to test_rpl_messages_vector (python/tests/test_vectors.py): outer msg_type chain ends in pytest.fail naming the vector and unknown type; inner malformed expect_error chain (same silent-pass defect, fell through to bare return) got the same treatment. Neither else fires on current rpl_messages.json content (types dio/dao/dis/dao_ack/option only). Full test_vectors.py: 780 passed. ruff: only pre-existing E501 (tracked by 8dv7). 3x codereview via reviewer model (kimi-k3): correctness PASS, security PASS, edge-cases no findings. Code commit dabf30c9a2 on beads-worker-5.
